newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease sees 96/97 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease sees 96/97 profit rise.

text.p: Property developer and financial services group Lend Lease Corp said on Thursday that it expected to increase net profit in the current financial year and would soon announce property investments in the United States, United Kingdom, and Thailand.

"I believe we continue to be in good shape and I am able to advise, as usual, that we expect to deliver another increased profit in the coming year," chairman Stuart Hornery told shareholders at the annual meeting.

Hornery later told Reuters the company, which is one of Australia's top 20 listed firms by market capitalisation, would also announce higher first half net earnings to December 31 but would not specify the amount.

Lend Lease, which is developing the A$1.7 billion Bluewater shopping complex in the English county of Kent and operates the MLC insurance and funds management group in Australia, achieved a 7.6 percent rise in 1995/96 (July/June) net profit to A$280 million.
Hornery said the expansion of the company's international property investments would be announced in the next three months, with each project worth more than A$100 million.
